Educational & Strategy
Execution · A1
Open variant A with the first topic and variant B with the second. Quoted topic anchors are not claims about existing visuals.
Quick Wins — This Week
Choose an experiment, prepare both variants, and predeclare the measurement window.
Experiment A1
Test H1 over 6 future posts, split evenly. Format: VIDEO. Keep timing and distribution comparable; record deviations.
Rationale · A1
Reuse material from
IG#post1
,
IG#post2
; compare against
CALC#VIDEO-comments_count
. This tests an existing creative direction without assuming a deficit.
Success Benchmarks
A higher mean is a signal for replication, not proof of causation or a promised gain. Reach and engagement are proxies, not verified sales or audience trust.
Success measure · A1
Compare mean comments per post in A versus B at the same post age. Report sample sizes and missing values. Historical reference: 11.5 from 4 measured VIDEO posts (
CALC#VIDEO-comments_count
).
Audience Profile
Data needed. Intended positioning in source copy does not verify audience demographics or behavior.
Road to a Measured Baseline
Decision milestone: complete the comparison, record uncertainty, then retain, revise or stop the tested direction. No follower or revenue forecast is inferred.
Audit Cadence
Review after the proposed test batch has reached a common measurement age. Keep captions, dates, variants and labelled outcomes so the next report can compare like with like.
